faq: Which store platforms do you support?

Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce are our main ones, and we can often add a chat widget to Wix or Squarespace stores too. Tell us your platform in the form and we confirm what is possible before starting.
Do you write over my existing product text?
No. Drafts appear in a review list and nothing changes in your store until you approve each one. We keep your original text so you can go back to it at any time.
Will it recommend products we do not stock?
No. Answers are limited to your catalog and policies. If a shopper asks something outside that, it points them to your contact page rather than inventing details.
Usage is billed by the AI provider to your own account, and a small store usually spends little. We set daily limits and show you how to read the bill. Our fee covers the set-up only.
